method: Whole-file manual reading of Swedish catalog; source bytes reverified; v91 automated structural evidence retained.
findings: Troliga dubbletter, Hashprefix and Stickprovshash retain probability/prefix/sampling distinctions. Sampling option explicitly specifies files over64MiB.

Recovery completion asks to check file data; Kan återställas and Kan kanske återställas remain separate. Metadata changes request rescan; same-source-volume restoration warns about overwriting deleted data. These labels do not establish recovery outcome.
Permanent deletion is described as permanent, without proving secure erasure. Cloud warning explains potential download and refers to settings.

Cleanup recursion label Återgå till underkataloger can read as returning to subdirectories rather than recursively processing them; backup/restore privilege label has awkward split wording. These are text-level observations.
Sparse action Gör fil gles differs from compression. Symbolic links, hardlinks and junctions have separate labels; logical/physical sizes and binary units remain distinct.

Regex alternative is wildcard characters rather than explicit glob terminology; custom cleanup tokens and ordered permission lists are retained. MSI sv-SE/1053/1252 declarations do not prove installer encoding.
limits: No Swedish Windows rendering, keyboard mnemonic conflict, installer/runtime or fluent native-speaker certification. No foreign production code adopted.
